description: Dept. of Co-operative Societies - Eastern Province  -  Conferment  of Powers of the Registrar, under the Co-operative Societies Rules
categorisation: This gazette notification specifically names individuals (Sooriyakumar Partheepan, Kaladevi Uthayarajah, Kanthaiya Vadivel Thangavel) and confers powers on them as appointed officials to assist the Commissioner of Co-operative Development. It focuses on personnel appointments and the conferment of powers to these named individuals, but does not include detailed descriptions of their portfolio responsibilities or subject matter areas. This fits the definition of Type 2 (People Gazette) which covers government personnel changes with basic titles only.
